en.title: ai
en.summary: This is the letter L319 from the vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters ai
paragraphs: The letters ai make the sound /eɪ/. You hear this main sound in (rain) /reɪn/, which means water that falls from clouds. This letter group makes three different sounds in English.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: For the first sound, open your mouth slightly and spread your lips wide. Move your jaw upward as your tongue glides toward your upper teeth. For the next sound, drop your jaw slightly and keep your tongue flat. For the last sound, relax your tongue and lips completely in the middle of your mouth. Your vocal cords vibrate for each sound.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In stressed syllables, the letters ai usually make the sound /eɪ/, as in (wait) /weɪt/. Before certain consonants, the letters ai make the short sound /ɛ/, as in (said) /sɛd/ or (air) /ɛər/. In unstressed syllables at the end of a word, this pair makes the weak sound /ə/, as in (captain) /kæp.tən/ and (curtain) /kɜːr.tən/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not read each letter separately as two vowels. Glide smoothly through the main sound instead of stopping halfway. In unstressed endings, do not say the long sound /eɪ/. Keep the final vowel very weak and short.
